spans.s: In the room of एतद् in the case of re-employment there is the substitution of the gravely accented अश् when the affixes त्र -- सप्तम्यास्त्रल्

follow, and the affixes त्र and तद् are अनुदात्त (gravely accented) also.

Terms: समास

The ऐ is substituted for ए forming part of the affixes of the first person of the लोट् (Imperative Mood).

Terms: लोट्

The substitute अश् comes in the place of एतद् when a प्राग्दिशीय affix follows.

Terms: प्राग्दिशीय - एतद्
After एतद् and तद् there is elision of the case-affix स् (of the Nominative Singular), when a consonant follows it, when these words are not combined with क (

) and have not the Negative Particle in composition.

Terms: संहितायाम्

For the ए coming after the द् of अदस् , there is substituted ई , and द् is changed to म् when plurality is to be expressed.

Terms: अदस् declension
